image_capabilities.name: Control-only Image attachment
image_capabilities.notes: Open_Image_Control uses the existing limited Image_Stream with zero image-layout fields, capabilities, communications, navigation and required metadata. Explicit application Buffer registration/unregistration is supported, but no internal image pool is allocated. Receive/frame leases refuse; unexpected delivered checkouts use the existing safe release engine without querying sample bytes, with uncertainty retention.

image_capabilities.name: Mono8 single-band
image_capabilities.notes: Implemented host pool and retained leases; supported() checks capability Mono/8/1, callback separately checks Mono/8/1, nonzero dimensions, known enums and buffer containment.

image_capabilities.name: Higher-bit-depth monochrome
image_capabilities.notes: Rejected by capability bitDepth == 8 and frame bitsPerPixel == 8 checks in native/src/ir_stream.cpp. This is an acquisition restriction only; Open_Image_Control does not validate or use an image layout.

image_capabilities.name: Packed pixel formats
image_capabilities.notes: No packed decoder or accepted packed path; buffer arithmetic is width * height bytes.

image_capabilities.name: RGB
image_capabilities.notes: Enum represented, but capability/frame format must equal Mono. This is an acquisition restriction only; Open_Image_Control does not validate or use an image layout.

image_capabilities.name: Bayer
image_capabilities.notes: Enum represented, but capability/frame format must equal Mono. This is an acquisition restriction only; Open_Image_Control does not validate or use an image layout.

image_capabilities.name: Multiband
image_capabilities.notes: Capability numberOfBands and frame numBands must both equal one. This is an acquisition restriction only; Open_Image_Control does not validate or use an image layout.

image_capabilities.name: Generic application-managed buffers
image_capabilities.notes: IRMEL-ADA-020: independently owned host Buffer registration/unregistration on C2, HealthStatus, StackedImage and control-only Image. Exact identity, disabled-only lifecycle and conservative ownership reconciliation; generic delivered-buffer checkout/release and full Mono8 application registration remain unavailable. Not generic acquisition parity.

image_capabilities.name: GPU/RDMA buffers
image_capabilities.notes: Not exposed as supported public paths. CPU host address containment/borrowing is not GPU or RDMA qualification.

image_capabilities.name: StackedImage
image_capabilities.notes: Required channel ownership/common communications, standalone Disable and explicit application Buffer registration/unregistration. No image-stack listener, StackFrameHeader conversion or optional LOS3D reception.
